label: maxFeedsPerDCPAgent setting
type: the number of index partitions one physical DCP connection to the Data service handles. Default 6; part of a rebalance-throughput tuning trio with maxConcurrentPartitionMovesPerNode and ftsMemoryQuota.
evidence: The default value for the maxFeedsPerDCPAgent setting is 6.
The maxFeedsPerDCPAgent setting refers to the number of index partitions a single physical connection to KV will handle.
relates_to_competency_question: How many index partitions share one DCP connection to the Data service, and can that be tuned?
